'''Terrence Ross''' (born February 5, 1991) is an American basketball player, most recently playing for the [[NCAA Division I]] [[Washington Huskies]].

==High School==
Ross played at [[Jefferson High School (Portland, Oregon)|Jefferson High School]] in [[Portland, Oregon]] his freshman and sophomore years. As a sophomore, Ross won the Oregon 5A Player of the Year, after leading Jefferson to the first of three consecutive state championships. He spent his junior season at [[Montrose Christian School]] in [[Rockville, Maryland]]. Ross returned to Jefferson High School his senior year, but he did not play basketball.<ref name=washprofile />

==College career==

===Freshman season===
In Ross' freshman season, he averaged 8.0 points, 2.8 rebounds and 1.0 assist per game. He was named Honorable Mention Pac-10 All-Freshman. Ross was also named to the Pac-10 All-Tournament team after averaging 15.3 points and 2.7 rebounds per game in the Pac-10 Tournament.

===Sophomore season===
In Ross' sophomore season, he averaged 16.4 points, 6.4 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game. This was good enough for Ross to be named to the First Team [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]]. Washington made it to the semifinals of the [[National Invitational Tournament]] in Ross' sophomore season, but then lost to the [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota Golden Gophers]]. In the NIT, Ross averaged 25 points and 5.5 rebounds per game.<ref name=washprofile>{{cite web|title=Terrence Ross Profile|url=http://www.gohuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/ross_terrence00.html|work=gohuskies.com|accessdate=26 May 2012}}</ref> On April 1, 2012 Ross decided to enter his name in the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Terrence Ross Declares for NBA Draft|url=http://www.gohuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040112aab.html|work=gohuskies.com|accessdate=26 May 2012}}</ref> Ross' Washington teammate [[Tony Wroten]] also decided to enter his name in the 2012 NBA Draft.<ref>{{cite web|title=Washington's Tony Wroten declares for the NBA Draft|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2012/story/_/id/7770913/washington-tony-wroten-declares-nba-draft|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=27 May 2012}}</ref>
